title: FilterDirect Subscriber Pounds on the Refrigerant Allowance, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
Customers who keep a FilterDirect subscription receive extra refrigerant allowance pounds on a completed Repair and Emergency Service Calls visit. The record read is the customer's subscription under FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions: whether it is in active status, and the MERV rating of the grade shipped.

**Rule.** A customer with an active FilterDirect subscription of MERV 13 or higher adds 0.4 pound to the refrigerant allowance pounds. One with an active FilterDirect subscription below MERV 13 adds 0.2 pound. A customer without an active subscription adds nothing. The pounds so added count toward the refrigerant allowance pounds before the pounds covered are taken.

| Active FilterDirect subscription | Pounds added |
|---|---|
| MERV 13 or higher (for example MERV 13 or MERV 16 grades) | 0.4 pound |
| Below MERV 13 (for example MERV 8 or MERV 11 grades) | 0.2 pound |
| None active (paused, cancelled, pending or never held) | Nothing |

## Boundary

MERV 13 is in the higher band and adds 0.4 pound. MERV 11 is below it and adds 0.2 pound.

## Example (hypothetical)

A member with an active MERV 11 subscription adds 0.2 pound. A member whose MERV 13 subscription is paused adds nothing.
